cells.brief: List 50 distinct ideas for a two-minute short film that can be shot in a single room with two actors. Number them 1 to 50. One sentence each.
ideas: A detective grills a suspect in a windowless room until the suspect angles a pocket mirror to show the detective’s own reflection in a hidden camera feed, revealing the interrogation is staged and flipping who is in control

An interviewer tells a nervous candidate they are unqualified until the candidate notices the interviewer’s monitor shows the candidate’s face on the company’s “CEO” profile, revealing the interview is a loyalty test and reversing the power

A landlord threatens eviction while a tenant silently fixes a leak until a reflection in the kitchen window reveals the landlord’s name is missing from the deed the tenant holds, making the tenant the actual owner

A boss fires an assistant until the assistant opens a laptop and turns it so the webcam view shows the boss’s signature on a fraudulent contract, revealing the assistant has been auditing him and seizing control

A date boasts about wealth until the other person adjusts a spoon to reflect the boastful one’s wrist tattoo matching a missing-person notice, revealing the date is an impostor and shifting fear to the exaggerator

A mother scolds her adult son for lying until he points at the baby monitor’s sightline into the hallway, revealing she has been hiding a second apartment key and the son has been locked in, reversing who is trapped

A doctor delivers a grave diagnosis until the patient notices the doctor’s eyeline keeps flicking to a chart with the wrong name, revealing the diagnosis belongs to the doctor and the patient must now comfort the authority figure

A landlord shows an apartment to a buyer until the buyer sees in the door’s peephole reflection that the landlord is wearing a wire, revealing the sale is a sting and the buyer takes control by opening the door

A lawyer pressures a client to plead guilty until the client tilts a glass of water to reflect the lawyer’s phone showing a payment from the prosecutor, revealing the lawyer’s betrayal and reversing the client’s position

A warden interviews an inmate for parole until the inmate points to the security monitor’s blind spot, revealing the warden has been secretly recording the interview and the inmate now controls the footage
A host demands a guest leave until the guest notices the window’s sightline shows the host’s car being towed, revealing the host is stranded and the guest becomes the one with power to stay
A creditor threatens a debtor until the debtor uses a phone’s black-screen reflection to show the creditor’s own overdue notice, revealing the creditor is also broke and the debt negotiation flips

A director auditions an actor until the actor sees the camera viewfinder’s line of sight is aimed at a hidden script page, revealing the director is reading lines and the actor takes over the audition

A critic insults a writer until the writer points at the laptop screen’s reflection showing the critic’s unpublished draft, revealing the critic plagiarized the writer and reversing the critique

A landlord’s agent demands a bribe until the tenant opens the blinds so the window’s sightline reveals the agent’s boss waiting outside, revealing the bribe was unauthorized and the tenant now holds the leverage
A police officer pressures a witness until the witness uses a keyhole’s sightline to show the officer’s partner listening, revealing the witness has been coached and the officer is the one exposed

A barber mocks a customer until the customer angles the mirror to show the barber’s reflection pocketing the customer’s wallet, revealing the theft and turning the customer into the one issuing orders

A chef berates a server until the server points to the pass-through window’s sightline showing the chef’s own order ticket marked “fired,” revealing the chef is about to be fired and the server becomes the bearer of bad news
A trainer belittles a client until the client sees in the mirror’s sightline that the trainer’s certificate is expired, revealing the trainer is unlicensed and the client takes charge of the session
A tenant begs for more time until the landlord notices the tenant’s phone reflection shows the eviction notice already signed by a judge, revealing the tenant has legal victory and reversing the plea

A stranger offers help in a locked room until the other sees in a picture frame’s glass that the helper is holding the missing key, revealing the helper locked them in and the trapped person becomes the interrogator
A boss demands loyalty until the employee turns a monitor so its reflection shows the boss deleting files, revealing the boss is the leak and the employee now has the power to expose him
A patient refuses medication until the doctor’s glasses reflection reveals the prescription is for the doctor, exposing a placebo test and reversing who is being treated
A sibling accuses the other of stealing inheritance until the accused opens a jewelry box whose mirror shows the accuser’s own key, revealing the accuser hid the will and the accused takes control
A security guard questions a visitor until the visitor points to the camera feed’s blind spot, revealing the guard has been asleep on duty and the visitor now dictates terms
A teacher scolds a student until the student uses the window’s reflection to show the teacher’s phone with the exam answers, revealing the teacher sold the test and the student becomes the accuser
A landlord inspects a room until the tenant adjusts a lamp so the sightline reveals the landlord’s hidden camera, exposing surveillance and flipping the tenant into the authority

A surgeon preps a patient until the patient sees in the instrument tray’s reflection that the surgeon’s hands are shaking, revealing the surgeon is impaired and the patient refuses the operation, taking control

A recruiter rejects an applicant until the applicant notices the recruiter’s screen reflection shows the applicant’s name on a layoff list, revealing the recruiter is about to lose his job and the applicant becomes the calm one
A spouse accuses the other of an affair until the accused angles a photo frame to show the accuser’s reflection in a hotel receipt, revealing the accuser is the one cheating and reversing the blame
A hostage-taker demands money until the hostage points out the window’s sightline reveals police already surrounding the building,
